status: architecture frozen after CCA-v1 outcomes and before selection or outcome access for a new temporal or prospective target; a target-specific execution appendix remains mandatory
claim_guard: This architecture records the post-CCA-v1 improvement without retuning the completed 13-program benchmark. It cannot change any CCA-v1 decision. It becomes confirmatory only after a target-specific appendix freezes the new programme, sources, candidate pool, representations, splits, thresholds, controls, endpoints, and outcome hashes before target outcome access.
scientific_hypothesis: Candidate-local source applicability and endpoint-specific source use can improve OOD decision utility beyond adjacency-only while limiting negative transfer on a target programme unseen during method development.

stages.name: contraindication_gate
stages.purpose: remove leakage and empirically non-specific sources
required_checks: canonical material, article, campaign, and time grouping
written physical, condition, or mechanism rationale
source uncertainty estimable without target-test outcomes
stages.source_oof_skill_use: continuous reliability covariate with uncertainty, not a universal binary admission threshold

stages.name: candidate_local_applicability
stages.purpose: separate useful and harmful regions inside a nominally adjacent edge
outcome_free_features: distance to source training support in the frozen representation
group-calibrated source ensemble or conformal uncertainty
agreement and disagreement among admitted source ranks
stages.cross_fitting: all source support and uncertainty quantities are estimated inside source groups

stages.name: endpoint_specific_borrowing
stages.prediction: cross-fitted source predictions enter through shrinkage with a point mass at zero
stages.fixed_screening: preserve source ranks and combine local support, rank consensus, and diversity
stages.breadth_exploration: one first-pass allocation per outcome-free family or provenance component
stages.adaptive_acquisition: allowed only if the target-only backbone beats uniform random; retain random and novelty arms

stages.name: abstention
stages.rule: borrow only when the lower calibrated bound on incremental utility exceeds the predeclared practical dead zone

minimum_validation.first_confirmatory_test: one genuinely temporal or prospective target programme
minimum_validation.general_policy_estimation: at least five independent programmes spanning at least two scientific families
minimum_validation.independent_unit: experimental programme or campaign, never ML seed

primary_family.multiplicity: Holm correction over exactly these two efficacy comparisons
primary_family.success: both programme-level 95% intervals are above zero and the safety and coverage guards pass

required_controls: size, skill, and coverage matched wrong source
novelty and uniform random for exploration
scientific_inspiration_card: source-specific proposed material family or condition
mandatory_target_specific_appendix: target identity and immutable outcome-access record
practical dead zone and uncertainty calibration
